articulation.initialization: exactly one world.reset() (bounded initialization, required to create the live articulation physics view; it internally plays and steps once); timeline stopped immediately after and never played or stepped again. The physics reset zeroes the USD link transforms in this Isaac build (live poses live in the PhysX fabric), so the FK convention is validated against the independent URDF zero-pose chain, not against USD link reads

tcp_definition.origin: midpoint of the area-weighted centroids of the two opposed distal finger contact patches
